laws.title: Intent Is Absolute
laws.enforced-by: deliver — G1; the receipt cites the spec version; lint — an emergency patch opens a spec-debt line

laws.title: The Spec Is the Contract
laws.enforced-by: deliver — G1, G2, G3 (build refuses a spec below the floor or not approved)

laws.title: Quality Through Context
laws.enforced-by: check — evidence links resolve; lint — assumptions marked assumed or evidenced

laws.title: Simplicity of Spec
laws.enforced-by: lint — a size limit per unit; criteria pointing at different decisions flagged as a likely split

laws.title: Code Is Regenerable
laws.enforced-by: lint — the spec version changes first; check — regenerated work re-runs every original acceptance test

laws.title: Resilience Over Robustness
laws.enforced-by: lint — a fix cites its spec change; every deployed unit has a rollback path

laws.title: Architecture Before Generation
laws.enforced-by: lint — a build unit points at a declared, signed structure; radar rings checked

laws.title: Comprehension Is Non-Negotiable
laws.enforced-by: check — reviewer and author differ; the review names a person; an explain-back is present

laws.title: Zero-Latency Evolution
laws.enforced-by: check — time from acceptance to deployment measured; a unit waiting with no stated reason flagged

laws.title: Feedback Closes the Loop
laws.enforced-by: lint — every demo record states what it taught; every feedback item has an owner

laws.title: Observability Is Non-Negotiable
laws.enforced-by: lint — each deployed unit declares its signal and its watcher

laws.title: Atomic Delivery
laws.enforced-by: check — each release item maps to one accepted unit and its receipt

laws.title: The Human as Governor
laws.enforced-by: deliver — every receipt signed by a named person, in every mode; the halt exercised

laws.title: Transparent Reasoning
laws.enforced-by: lint — every tracker claim carries a path to its evidence; every act records person or agent

laws.title: Security by Design
laws.enforced-by: deliver — G1 (a threat section in every spec); G2 (threat coverage meets its floor)

laws.title: Alignment Before Demonstration
laws.enforced-by: deliver — G4 (witnessed proofs); required checks follow the recorded mode

laws.title: Records append
laws.enforced-by: check, lint — rewrite detection; superseded text archived, never deleted

laws.title: Evidence is a path
laws.enforced-by: check — evidence links resolve; lint — claims carry paths

laws.title: Answers recorded verbatim
laws.enforced-by: human review — decisions asked with a recommendation, recorded exactly as given

laws.title: Hashes detect, humans declare
laws.enforced-by: upgrade — payload verified by structure-hash and content-checksums before vendoring; build — version-sanity refusal

laws.title: The tool witnesses
laws.enforced-by: deliver — G4; growth: the tool runs the proof and records its output

laws.title: Proof is bound to the exact work it proves
laws.enforced-by: deliver — G4; the receipt cites the spec version and the exact state the proof ran against

laws.title: Verifiable by a stranger
laws.enforced-by: check — proofs record what ran and what came back; growth: the recorded command beside the output, re-runnable by anyone

laws.title: Machine-first records, human-rendered views
laws.enforced-by: design law — views are rendered from the record, never hand-maintained beside it

laws.title: Provenance without attribution by default
laws.enforced-by: direction — every act records person or agent, tool and model names opt-in; growth: the provenance field linted

laws.title: Gates near the machine, pictures near the person
laws.enforced-by: design law — gates are exit codes and envelopes; what people see are pictures, not verdicts

laws.title: The mode invariants
laws.enforced-by: deliver — a named signer on every receipt; the halt tested and recorded on the trail

laws.title: Never score a person
laws.enforced-by: human review — the tool carries no per-person metrics; the Anti-Surveillance Distinction

laws.title: Bounded and indexed
laws.enforced-by: direction — size thresholds and an index that says what is where; growth: lint warns at the thresholds

laws.title: The Anti-Complexity Principle
laws.enforced-by: human review — the test every addition must pass

laws.title: Owner-only decisions go to the owner
laws.enforced-by: human review — asked with a recommendation, answered by the owner of the work
